terms.grammar: deponent verb, third conjugation, with the ablative
evidence: Cic. Tusc. 5.32.90: lacte, cāseō, carne (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: What one lives on goes into the ablative: lacte vescuntur, they live on milk.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 340.
